facts.fact: The NYC Business Express Service Team (NYC BEST) connects businesses to a single point person to help them get licenses and permits faster and avoid or reduce fines and violations.
facts.quote: Through NYC BEST, you will be connected to a single point person to help you: Get licenses and permits faster Avoid/reduce fines and violations

facts.fact: The NYC Cannabis NYC hotline phone number is 888-SBS-4NYC (888-727-4692).
The Shop Your City page lists 3 top ways to support neighborhood small businesses: shop in person, shop online, and buy a gift card.
facts.quote: Here are the top 3 ways you can support the small businesses that make our city a unique place to live

facts.fact: The Dining Out NYC application deadline is August 3 (8/3), as listed on the SBS page; the year is not stated.
facts.quote: Dining Out NYC, New York City's permanent outdoor dining program. Apply by 8/3.

facts.fact: The Online Directory of Certified Businesses lists M/WBE, LBE, and EBE certified businesses across the New York City area, with company details and contact information.
facts.quote: The Online Directory of Certified Businesses is a searchable list of M/WBE, LBE, and EBE certified businesses across the New York City area.
